conventions.stage_xy: 0..1; x left to right, y from the back wall (0) to the audience (1)
conventions.rotation_deg: 0 faces the audience, 90 faces right, 180 faces the back wall, 270 faces left

conditions.narrative_purpose: Warmth that comes from the room itself, so the audience believes in the place before it believes in the argument.
